digest.component_or_area: Plan review gate measurement and validation (E3 story, R1 gating)
propositions: Deterministic E3 infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, metrics library) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main because the replay driver only serves the rejected batch.

The expensive ~450-run LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise 50-ticket candidate/current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds and is superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder which accumulates verdict-perturbation signal from production at zero marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is non-viable: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 required because the impact_model_version bump stranded the historical data.
The recall-stripped clone design (copy store, delete REVIEW_RESULT.json, run over clone) removes recall contamination and baseline drift confounds to isolate true candidate gate effect.
R1 false-positive gating criterion requires ≤3/30 new blocking findings and ≤1 median new advisory count delta on 30 sampled cleanly-closed plans, with ≤2% PASS→BLOCK flip rate on wider sample.

The deterministic half delivers reproducible metrics (criterion_deltas, build_matrix, tkey, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval, fp_control_valid) with golden-test coverage, intentionally left as auditable WIP rather than shipped code.
